title: 第15章 大壮，你太猛了~~~
slug: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
跑在最前面那个二流子举着木棍就往李大壮头上砸！

    “大壮小心啊！”

    李家二老和李秋霜都紧张的喊了起来，李秋霜更是屏住了气，胸口起伏高涨，几乎要把薄薄的夏衣给撑爆了！

    李大壮丝毫不慌，侧身躲过二流子的攻击，顺手抓住木棍，猛地一拽，二流子重心不稳，摔了个狗啃泥，李大壮抬脚就往他背上踩，直接踩得他动弹不得。

    另一个二流子想从侧面偷袭，李大壮速度飞快的反手一拳，对方还没看清咋回事呢，就觉得眼眶处咔嚓一声，竟然是眼骨都被打裂了！

    “啊！！我的眼睛！我的眼睛瞎了！！”那二流子惨叫一声，捂着直往外冒血的眼睛倒在了地上！

    剩下的几个二流子也没一个能撑过李大壮的拳脚，要么被砸中脸颊，要么被踹断肋骨，没一会儿就全都倒在地上，哀嚎一片，再也不敢嚣张！

    王家父子俩看着这一幕，简直又惊又惧，李大壮不傻了也就罢了，咋还这么能打了！？

    李大壮则是脸色阴沉的朝他俩走过去。

    “你，你想干啥！？”王有财对上李大壮那狠厉的眼神，竟吓得双腿发抖，要不是顾忌儿子还跪倒在地上动弹不得，他都想逃跑了！

    “干啥？当然是废了你儿子的命根子，免得他再惦记不该惦记的人！”

    “不！不要！！”

    王耀根吓得瑟瑟发抖，一把鼻涕一把泪：“爸，你救我，救救我啊！这傻逼崽子要是废了我，咱们家就绝后了啊！”

    “李大壮我警告你别乱来！我可是杏花村村长！”王有财一听要绝后，也是怕的不行，色厉内荏的威胁道：“我在镇上也有不少人脉，执法所的张队长前两天刚跟我喝了酒！”

    “你要是敢废我儿子命根子，我一定让你进去吃牢饭！”

    “呵，你可以试试！”李大壮冷笑着说了这么一句，忽然猛的出手，在王耀根后腰处用力点了两下！

    王有财根本来不及阻挡，就看见宝贝儿子忽然腰身一软，躺倒在了地上：“坏了！爸！我的腰子真废了！咋一点力气都没了！完了！我完了啊！呜呜呜！”

    王耀根哪里还有一点之前的嚣张模样，竟没出息的哭了起来！

Li Dazhuang watched the white space getting closer and closer, and the fragrance became more and more attractive. The impulse surged in his heart, his eyes were burning, and he could no longer hold it back...

"Hmm~"

He Meier's red lips parted slightly and she let out a seductive scream, and her delicate figure couldn't help but twist.

Li Dazhuang was even more delighted. After living for twenty years, it was the first time he felt such a warm and fragrant nephrite. He finally understood the essence of the old saying: It's cool to be a ghost under the peony flower!

But while Li Dazhuang was busy, a light flashed in He Meier's beautiful eyes, and she puffed up her chest!

The next second, Li Dazhuang suddenly felt a fragrance drifting into his mouth. He was about to taste it carefully, but he felt that the fragrance floated into his brain, followed by a heart-piercing pain that gradually spread from his brain to his whole body!

"Ah! It hurts!"

Li Dazhuang screamed and fell to the ground in pain, holding his head and rolling around!

"If you want to achieve my level of cultivation in a mortal body, you must first be reborn. The process will be painful, but it can bring you back to life!"

Along with He Meier's charming voice, countless information crazily poured into Li Dazhuang's mind: Taoist medical skills, martial arts, spiritual perception, yin and yang cultivation...

After an unknown amount of time, the severe pain in Li Dazhuang's body slowly subsided, replaced by endless strength and many unfamiliar but powerful abilities!

Li Dazhuang was surprised and happy. Not only was he no longer stupid, he actually got He Meier's inheritance!?

With these skills, wouldn't it be possible to reach the sky in one step in the future, make money and beautify people, wouldn't it be a matter of course!

"Thank you, ancestor, for gifting me with cultivation. I just don't know if ancestor is still willing to teach me the art of dual cultivation in person?"

With his cultivation, Li Dazhuang became much bolder in his speech. Even when faced with the shockingly beautiful and charming ancestor of the Hehuan Sect, he dared to test with a smirk.

"Silly boy~ Do you think I don't want to teach you personally?" He Meier's tone was resentful, and a look of regret appeared on her extremely beautiful face. The snow-white body that was originally clearly visible was gradually fading!

Li Dazhuang stared blankly at the white pair in front of He Meier. He hadn't seen enough yet. Why did he feel like it was about to dissipate?

"Back then, I couldn't recognize people, and I was trapped here in a trap. I should have been dead long ago, but I kept holding on just to wait for you, a silly boy. Now that I have given all my cultivation to you, I no longer have the energy to support you!"

"You must remember to practice diligently and practice Yin and Yang dual cultivation with all kinds of beauties. If you can ascend to immortality as soon as possible, you can save my remaining soul from here, and you can also help me find a physical body. When the time comes, I can truly cultivate dual cultivation with you..."

As He Meier's voice fell, her snow-white and delicate body actually disappeared!

"Sister Mei'er, don't worry, I will definitely listen to you, practice more with beauties, and rescue you as soon as possible!"

Just when Li Dazhuang was regretting not being able to practice dual cultivation with He Meier, he vaguely heard a familiar voice calling for help!

"It's Sister-in-law Meiyu!"
